name: 06489 · Southington, CT
findings: ZIP 06489 (Southington) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06489 (Southington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06489 (Southington) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.9 times the typical level).
